c2_reason: apt downloads the packages again when needed: a cache (S2.2-5).

name: /var/cache/debconf
c1_what: Stores debconf answers, templates, previous databases, and temporary directory.

c2_what: debconf answer, template and password databases
c2_reason: Contents of databases: after removal programs run the same and only stored answers are unavailable (S2.2-4).

name: /var/cache/ldconfig

c1_reason: Auxiliary metadata is regenerated; removal costs rescanning time.
c2_what: ldconfig auxiliary cache
c2_reason: A cache ldconfig rebuilds (S2.2-5).

name: /var/cache/man
c1_what: Stores manual indexes, cache tags, and language directories.
c1_reason: Indexes: NOT as caches; tags: NOT as cache metadata. Directories: UNKNOWN without functional dependency evidence.

name: /var/lib/apt
c1_what: Stores package selection state, downloaded lists, and synchronization objects.
c1_reason: Lists: NOT as cache. extended_states: MUST for automatic-removal decisions. lock: UNKNOWN. Directory: UNKNOWN. Mirror links: MUST for source selection.
c2_what: apt package indexes, list lock and extended_states
c2_reason: Package indexes and lock behave as cache apt fetches again (S2.2-5); extended_states is apt's program state, outside the definition (S2.5-1).

name: /var/lib/cloud

c2_what: cloud-init instance state (instance ID, semaphores, user-data copies)
c2_reason: cloud-init's program state; how to treat program state is a design question outside the definition (S2.5-1).
